description: This file defines API endpoints for streaming video content with HTTP Range support. It includes functions for proxying video byte streams from upstream URLs, handling Range headers, and managing streaming responses using FastAPI and aiohttp.

methods.name: StreamingResponse _proxy_range_stream(url: str, range_header: Optional[str])
methods.description: Asynchronously proxies a video stream from a remote URL, supporting Range headers by forwarding requests and streaming chunks with proper headers and status codes.
